decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Omniscience Combo, which allows the player to play spells for free. Utilizing cards like Marang River Regent and Fallaji Archaeologist to generate tokens and Moment of Truth to draw cards, the deck aims to control the board with spells like Ephara's Dispersal and stock up on resources with Abuelo's Awakening. With cards like Roiling Dragonstorm and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent, the deck seeks to establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and pump spells to deal heavy damage quickly. The deck utilizes creatures with haste and abilities that trigger when they attack to apply pressure early in the game. The pump spells and combat tricks help to push through damage and maintain board presence. With a mix of creatures with different abilities and low mana cost spells, the deck aims to consistently deal damage and control the pace of the game. The mana base is optimized to ensure a smooth curve and consistent access to mana sources.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage are used to further increase damage output. The deck also includes card draw and scry effects to maintain hand advantage and consistency. The mana base is balanced between Islands and Mountains, with additional dual lands for color fixing and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence and dealing damage early on in the game. By playing low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, along with efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning, the goal is to continuously pressure the opponent and keep them on the defensive. The deck also includes card draw and scrying effects to maintain consistency and ensure that the aggression never lets up. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast-paced aggression and efficient spell usage.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly build a board presence with low-cost creatures like Picklock Prankster and Abhorrent Oculus, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Negate. Cards like Recommission and Helping Hand provide additional support for the creatures on the field. The deck also includes card draw and scrying effects like Sleight of Hand and Chart a Course to help maintain card advantage. Kiora, the Rising Tide can be used to generate extra mana and flood the board with creatures, while Haughty Djinn and Into the Flood Maw provide additional threats for the opponent to deal with.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells like Day of Judgment and Lightning Helix, as well as counterspells like Dispelling Exhale. Additionally, it relies on powerful card draw engines such as Meticulous Archive and Temporary Lockdown to outvalue opponents in the late game. The deck also includes powerful threat cards like Marang River Regent and Beza, the Bounding Spring to quickly close out games once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The main goal is to control the game and win through incremental advantage and card advantage.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan by utilizing a variety of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw. With a mix of control elements like Split Up, Temporary Lockdown, and Get Lost, combined with powerful finishers like Marang River Regent and Shiko, Paragon of the Way, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. The mana base is built to support the three-color combination of Jeskai while also providing consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm your opponent quickly. With a mix of low-cost instants and sorceries to control the board, combined with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher, you can apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game. Using cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt to dig for key pieces, along with Stock Up to refill your hand, you can keep the pressure on while maintaining card advantage. Shivan Reef and Spirebluff Canal ensure you have the mana you need to keep the pressure up.

The main concept behind this Dimir Aggro deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. Cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down help to remove threats, while creatures like Spyglass Siren and Deep-Cavern Bat deal damage and provide card advantage. By combining efficient removal and powerful creatures, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through a mix of tempo plays and aggressive tactics.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy and control the game by using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. By efficiently managing your resources and making strategic decisions, you can stall the game until you can establish a dominant board presence with powerful creatures like Marang River Regent and Beza, the Bounding Spring. The deck also features cards like Lightning Helix for additional removal and life gain to help stabilize against aggressive strategies. With proper timing and careful planning, you can outlast your opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence and dealing damage to the opponent as fast as possible. By utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures and versatile spells, the aim is to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes some control elements to disrupt opponent's strategies. The varied creatures and spells provide a range of threats and answers, making it a versatile and dynamic deck to play. The mana base allows for quick and consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for the spells in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize efficient and aggressive creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Marauding Mako, backed up by powerful instant and sorcery spells like Torch the Tower and Profit's Eidetic Memory. The goal is to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that momentum with a mix of evasive creatures and damage spells. The mana base is designed to support the three-color combination of Jeskai while ensuring a consistent mana curve. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and decisively.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble and utilize the Omniscience Combo, which allows the player to cast spells without paying their mana costs. The deck focuses on drawing cards, countering opponent's spells, and generating mana to eventually cast powerful spells such as Roiling Dragonstorm. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo and set up win conditions. Through a combination of card draw, control elements, and powerful combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Nurturing Pixie, Sunpearl Kirin, and Overlord of the Balemurk. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Scrollshift, Temporary Lockdown, and Nowhere to Run to control the board and create openings for lethal attacks. The deck includes key cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Serra Paragon for additional power and versatility. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and land support, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the battlefield throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent, utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. The key strategy is to maintain board presence while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total, overwhelming them with a relentless assault of creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to end the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize and turn the tide in their favor.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to rapidly build up a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent early in the game. Utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Hearth Elemental, along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and overwhelm the opponent. By including card draw options like Sleight of Hand and Opt, the deck ensures it maintains a steady stream of threats to keep the pressure on and maintain a tempo advantage throughout the match.
